changes: One reusable native service proof worker and reply slot; every command still receives a fresh service query. Timeout permanently fences unconsumed replies; exact query/handle retirement is joined.

Native request write duration recorded using reserved bytes in the existing 68-byte diagnostic suffix; no extra input/network exchange. Parent Write completion can overlap child read and is not a disjoint phase.
Panic and Goexit cannot publish a successful proof; authority, desktop freshness, uncertainty and no-replay rules preserved.

Vet passed for seven affected packages; git diff --check passed.
Frontend tests/native build, update-transfer smoke, icon/archive validation and app setup verification passed.
Actual A setup installed/result-zero receipt, both exact installed revisions/UI launch records, protected input READY, complete installations and same peer connection verified.
limits: No controlled post-install physical trial yet: neither the 33.173ms child handler nor 11.406ms request-to-read tail is claimed resolved.

Existing timings cannot distinguish scheduler delay from native call time precisely. New request-write metadata is needed to assess the next slow delivery sample; it does not prove kernel arrival or pure network delay.
One proof goroutine and fixed reply slot remain resident per bound native child; no new input authority is granted. A genuinely blocked native query still requires exact retirement.
Initial connected observation excludes installation-time disconnections and historical failures; it is not long-term recovery stability evidence.
